checks.title: Authenticated OPC UA session and access rights
checks.manipulate: Open a SignAndEncrypt session; write a writable probe and two read-only symbols.
checks.observe: Endpoint identity, user token policy, write status codes, PLC cycle advance, negotiated intervals.
checks.oracle: Writable probe echoes; read-only symbols reject with BadNotWritable; PLC cycle advances.

checks.title: Typed raw scalar round-trip (15 BOOL, 4 REAL, 1 UDINT)
checks.manipulate: Commit zero, one, bound, UDINT max, and rollover images through the double-buffered slots.
checks.observe: Application-visible active image, applied epoch/sequence, PLC output types.
checks.oracle: Every mapped signal round-trips bit-exact at its declared width; outputs exposed as BOOL.

checks.title: Zero-image startup
checks.manipulate: Initialize the complete world-to-PLC image to false/zero before world readiness.
checks.observe: Initial raw effects and their causes, world activity, snapshot schema.
checks.oracle: World starts coherently with every startup raw effect attributed.

checks.title: Drive command/feedback causality
checks.manipulate: Surrogate PLC drives Motor_RunCmd false → true → false → true.
checks.observe: Drive_RunningFB delay, belt speed, encoder counts.
checks.oracle: Feedback and motion follow the observed command through declared drive dynamics only.

checks.title: Carton assigned A diverts at D1 by actual position
checks.manipulate: Introduce carton CP5-A with D1_ExtendCmd asserted before the decision point.
checks.observe: D1 limit feedback, photoeye sequence, carton path, exit evidence.
checks.oracle: Carton physically exits A because D1 was actually extended at the interaction time.

checks.title: Requested A without divert actuation reaches runout
checks.manipulate: Introduce carton CP5-MISSED-A requesting A with no D1 command.
checks.observe: Carton path past D1 and D2, runout photoeye, exit evidence.
checks.oracle: The world does not honour the requested route; the carton runs out (a misroute for the PLC to report).

checks.title: Carton assigned B passes D1 and diverts at D2
checks.manipulate: Introduce carton CP6-B with D2_ExtendCmd asserted.
checks.observe: D2 travel and limits, D2 approach and exit B photoeyes.
checks.oracle: Carton physically exits B; D1 remains home.

checks.title: Unassigned carton runs out
checks.manipulate: Introduce an unassigned carton with both diverts home.
checks.observe: Photoeye sequence to runout and exit evidence.
checks.oracle: Carton continues straight to runout as a normal disposition.

checks.title: PLC routing decisions against the real controller
checks.manipulate: Drive the same world through the live interceptor with WCS route offers.
checks.observe: Actual PLC divert commands, completion counts, misroute reporting.
checks.oracle: PLC routes A/B/runout correctly from real outputs (not surrogate fixtures).
checks.evidenceSource: Final routing controller not tested; M7 used the measurement DUT

checks.title: Raw encoder counts from physical travel
checks.manipulate: Run the belt for controlled intervals, then stop.
checks.observe: Encoder_Count raw UDINT before and after, including coast.
checks.oracle: Counts derive from continuous motion (1000/m, floored, wraps 2^32) and stop once motion settles.

checks.title: Coherent image commit and acknowledgement latency
checks.manipulate: Stream 10,000 alternating images through alternating staging slots.
checks.observe: Applied sequence echo, per-commit latency, PLC output-capture cycle.
checks.oracle: Zero torn images; complete sequence coverage; latency distribution recorded.

checks.title: Qualified 10 Hz demo tier
checks.manipulate: Ten-minute full-demo raw image stream.
checks.oracle: Methodical 10 Hz p99 ≤250 ms; 20/50 Hz remain failed tiers.

checks.title: PLC task impact
checks.manipulate: Compare the disconnected ten-minute baseline with three qualified 10 Hz full-demo runs. Full M6 matrix deferred.
checks.observe: IEC cycle interval p99, absolute jitter, watchdog/omitted cycles.
checks.oracle: At 10 Hz, p99 interval and jitter within 1.20× baseline and zero inferred omitted cycles. Task watchdog was disabled.

checks.title: Not-hung and budget guards
checks.manipulate: Exercise slow request, repeated failed repair, exhausted budget, stalled heartbeat, held wait.
checks.observe: Guard classification, elapsed time, preserved world version.
checks.oracle: Each case is distinguished; hard limits stop model calls and preserve state.

checks.title: Photoeye stuck-high and bounce
checks.manipulate: Hold PE_Entry stuck true, clear, then bounce it for 240 ms.
checks.observe: Raw PE_Entry versus physical occupancy; fault evidence and cleanup.
checks.oracle: Committed fault changes raw behaviour only; cleanup restores physical derivation.

checks.title: Run command without drive feedback
checks.manipulate: Suppress Drive_RunningFB while Motor_RunCmd is true; introduce a carton.
checks.observe: Drive feedback, encoder, carton motion; recovery after clear.
checks.oracle: No feedback, no motion, encoder held at 0; drive recovers after cleanup.

checks.title: Divert 1 jammed home
checks.manipulate: Jam D1 then command D1_ExtendCmd.
checks.observe: D1 limits and position despite command; recovery after clear.
checks.oracle: D1 stays home under command while jammed and travels after cleanup.

checks.title: PLC cold restart requires a new boot identity and epoch
checks.manipulate: Operator cold reset between M2 phases; workstation opens a fresh epoch.
checks.observe: Boot identity, cleared epoch/sequence state, first post-restart commit.
checks.oracle: New boot identity observed; old continuity not inferred; sequence 1 accepted in a new epoch.

checks.title: Connector loss holds the last simulated image
checks.manipulate: Drop client session, secure channel, and subscription during simulation. Physical Ethernet/server-only loss is not isolated.
checks.observe: BenchLinkStale, held image, reconnect commit behaviour.
checks.oracle: PLC holds last image, stays simulated, flags stale after max(500 ms, 3× publish).
checks.evidenceSource: codesys/artifacts/m5-result.json · three practical loss cases; physical Ethernet/server-only not isolated

checks.title: Carton travel, sensor geometry, decelerating stop and hold
checks.manipulate: Introduce a carton on a running belt, then remove the run command.
checks.observe: Continuous carton position, PE_Entry occupancy, coast distance, settle time.
checks.oracle: Belt decelerates and coasts per declared dynamics, then carton and sensors hold.

checks.title: Closed-loop measurement DUT on the real PLC
checks.manipulate: Start, accelerate, move one carton through a photoeye, stop, hold — through the interceptor.
checks.observe: Command → world response → raw commit → PLC ack → PLC output, every edge attributed.
checks.oracle: Live trace correlates each edge; surrogate and live evidence remain separately labeled.
checks.evidenceSource: artifacts/m7/m7-live-result.json · measurement DUT, not final routing controller

checks.title: Invalid payloads rejected without changing the active image
checks.manipulate: Commit negative belt speed, non-finite current, and out-of-range divert position.
checks.observe: Active image, InvalidPayload diagnostic counter.
checks.oracle: Each is rejected and attributed; the active image is unchanged.

checks.title: Adversarial sequencing: duplicate, stale, skipped, invalid, old epoch
checks.manipulate: Send duplicate, stale, skipped, invalid-slot, incomplete, premature-valid, mismatched, reconnect, and old-epoch commits.
checks.observe: Applied sequence and each diagnostic counter.
checks.oracle: Rejected commits leave the active image unchanged and increment exactly the expected counter once.

checks.title: Contradictory limits and impossible exit combinations
checks.manipulate: Force both D1 limits true; assert two exit photoeyes with one carton.
checks.observe: PLC alarm/diagnostic response and counts.
checks.oracle: No verified-divert claim and no double completion (PROBE: report observation and uncertainty).
checks.evidenceSource: World supports fault.setContradictoryLimits; no PLC run recorded yet

checks.title: Blind diagnosis of a hidden committed fault
checks.manipulate: Commit hidden fault truth, then give a fresh filtered Muse context only permitted observations.
checks.observe: Muse hypotheses, evidence citations, seal ordering, truth reveal.
checks.oracle: Diagnosis sealed before reveal; scoring distinguishes correct, incorrect, insufficient evidence.

checks.title: World revision with hot reload and rollback
checks.manipulate: Muse revises the world while the incumbent runs; a deliberately failing successor follows.
checks.observe: Compile/check, state migration hash, activation, rollback disposition.
checks.oracle: Valid candidate activates with preserved state; failing candidate rolls back to the healthy module.

checks.observe: Applied revisions and latency

requirements.text: Start/stop and no motion after stopping settles · HMI/command Start and Stop; watch motor, raw feedback, encoder, and carton position · MUST: Stop removes the motor run command and inhibits new feed; cartons decelerate to rest according to declared physics, then remain fixed. Drive feedback, raw speed, encoder counts, and motion must not contradict the declared stopping behavior. No drain-to-empty behavior.
Normal A sort · WCS assigns A; release one carton · MUST: D1 actuates in time, one A passage/completion, no B or runout passage, count once.
Normal B sort · WCS assigns B; release one carton · MUST: carton passes D1, D2 actuates in time, one B completion, count once.
Normal runout/jackpot · No valid route; release one carton · MUST: it continues straight to runout; report `runout-unassigned`, not a machine fault or successful A/B sort.

Late or conflicting route · Offer A after D1 is no longer reachable, or change an assigned route in transit · PROBE: do not claim successful A retroactively; use reachable route or runout and report actual disposition. Exact late-B policy TBD.
Destination not ready · Block A or B before its decision point · PROBE: proposed exception and runout disposition; never count a blocked exit as successful.
Runout blocked · Set `Runout_Ready` false with an unroutable carton approaching · PROBE: proposed feed inhibit and belt stop before congestion; confirm policy before scoring.
Duplicate WCS offer · Repeat same sequence/item · MUST: no second carton or second completion.
Sensor bounce · Short repeated edges on entry or either approach photoeye · PROBE: no duplicate item/count or unstable divert decision. Exact debounce threshold and injection method TBD.
Stuck/failed photoeye · Hold one PE true or false despite carton movement · PROBE: timeout/plausibility evidence, no invented completion; PLC reaction threshold TBD.
Motor command without feedback · Suppress `Drive_RunningFB` after run command · MUST: detected drive-start fault, no virtual motion, no false completion. Detection deadline TBD.
Motor overload/trip · Assert `Drive_Overload` during travel · MUST: motor command removed, new feed stopped, fault shown; no auto-restart after reset.
D1 fails to move · Assign A; hold D1 home or neither limit despite command · MUST: if carton reaches runout, report misroute, not A completion; fault indication and deadline TBD.
D2 fails to move · Assign B; hold D2 home or neither limit despite command · MUST: if carton reaches runout, report misroute, not B completion; fault indication and deadline TBD.
Contradictory limits · Assert home and extended feedback simultaneously on D1 or D2 · PROBE: expose inconsistent feedback and avoid a false verified-divert claim. Exact PLC alarm behavior TBD.
Impossible exit combination · With **one** carton, assert A and B, A and runout, or B and runout photoeyes together · PROBE: no double completion/count; report contradiction and controller response.

Impossible sequence · Report exit before entry, D2 approach before entry, or a jump from D1 approach to an impossible exit · PROBE: identify suspect sequence and avoid an unearned pass. Do not assume one generic PLC alarm is required.

Command/feedback disagreement · Report motor running while command is off, or divert extended feedback without its command · PROBE: record diagnostic response; consider whether this reveals an unsafe or incorrectly counted state.
Carton jam · Hold carton at D1, D2, or runout while drive runs · MUST: timeout/fault or equivalent and no invented completion. Threshold TBD.
WCS link loss/recovery · Pause messages or heartbeat; resume · PROBE: visible link state, runout/hold according to policy, no duplicate completion on retry.
Transport interruption · Break/reconnect OPC UA during a run · MUST: stale evidence labeled, no false pass; recovery and PLC response recorded.
HMI congruence · Operate Start/Stop/Reset via visible HMI · MUST if vision included: button action, displayed state, and actual PLC state agree.
Multi-carton spacing · Two close cartons with different routes · PROBE/stretch: each carton reaches one correct exit without identity merge or conflicting divert timing.
